title: OPV-DB (extended): a literature-mined organic photovoltaic device performance database
description:
An extended OPV-DB release derived from the original OPV-DB by Qiu, J. and merged with an independently literature-mined organic photovoltaic device-record collection. Contains a consolidated single-junction device table with strict performance and strict molecular benchmark tier columns, a material-reference table, and validation summaries.

This release is a derivative of the original OPV-DB (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20841543, CC BY 4.0); please cite that work as well.
